build_scattering_matrix_for_layer_stack: build a python module to compute the scattering matrix for a stack of layers using stack_s_matrix
create_scattering_matrix_with_scan: create a function that computes the scattering matrix for a stack of layers using jax.lax.scan for faster compilation
compute_redheffer_star_product: compute the Redheffer star product of two scattering matrices to combine them into a single scattering matrix
append_layer_to_scattering_matrix: append a new layer to an existing scattering matrix and return the updated scattering matrix
modify_end_layer_thickness: modify the end layer thickness of a scattering matrix and return the updated scattering matrix
